input.quote: (e) THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL BE IN LIEU OF ALL OTHER WARRANTIES, EXPRESS OR IMPLIED, INCLUDING THE IMPLIED WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY, FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
input.rationale: Section 5 gives only compliance-with-law, authority and non-infringement warranties, and Section 1(b) contains a professional/workmanlike performance covenant. There is no warranty that the Works or deliverables will conform to the Specifications or documentation, no warranty period, and no remedy (re-performance, repair/replacement or refund); the Section 5(e) "in lieu of all other warranties" disclaimer then strips the implied warranties that would otherwise fill that gap. That fails even the fallback (90 days for software/deliverables with real remedies), so we insert a 90-day conformity warranty plus repair/replace/refund remedy (and a no-malicious-code assurance) before the disclaimer. The disclaimer itself preserves express warranties, so we do not otherwise touch it, and liability caps are addressed under LOL-CAP.

ops.text: Contractor represents and warrants to Company that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each of the Works and deliverables provided under a Statement of Work will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation, and that the Works will not contain any virus, malicious or disabling code. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, Works or deliverables, or a refund of the fees paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a 90-day conformity warranty for deliverables plus a repair/replace/refund remedy, since the current Section 5 contains no performance warranty or remedy for non-conforming Works. This matches our playbook fallback position (90 days for deliverables) and leaves the existing workmanlike standard in Section 1(b) intact.
proposal.summary: Insert 90-day deliverable conformity warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy into Section 5.
